dossier_meta.context_text: The paper establishes $\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}-\varepsilon\right)\sqrt{n\log n}\leq\vec{a}(n)\leq\frac{107}{8}\sqrt{n}\log n$, a logarithmic gap between lower and upper bounds. The authors believe the upper bound can be sharpened to $C\sqrt{n\log n}$ by analysing a suitable orientation of the triangle-free process $G_{\triangle}$.
